_what: The steps of the video edit, in order. run.py and the page both read this list — nothing else decides what runs.

steps.what: Collect what was approved upstream: A-roll clips, B-roll clips, the one voice track with its word timings, music, sound effects. Anything not approved is refused by name.
Write the cut sheet: which clip covers which words, where B-roll covers A-roll, trims, sound levels. Reads the brief, the teardown's roll labels and everything the owner has changed before.
steps.fallback: auto — clips in scene order laid on the voice timings

steps.what: Check the cut sheet before anything renders: every file exists, no hole in the picture, trims inside the source, captions inside the frame and the runtime, every look and transition on its list. Red names the field.
STOP 1 — the timeline page: every layer as bars on one clock, dead space already out. Approve, or say what to change in plain words.
STOP 2 — captions on, in the chosen look, shown as real frames from the edit. Approve, switch the look, or fix a word.
Write the HyperFrames page from the cut sheet, run its own checks, render the final file.

audit.py on the finished file, every version: words chopped at a cut, lips against their own clip, words off every face and mouth read on the finished frames, the music and sound effects the swipe has. A finding holds the version (E12–E15, 2026-10-21).
The quality lane on the finished file: length matches the sheet, picture never black, voice level and music level in range, captions in time with the words.
File the record to runs/video-edit/<brand>/<label>/ and the video to the same path on the Drive, named by the naming convention.
Every change the owner made at a stop, with the why, becomes a rule the next cut reads.

line._what: the edit-map line's steps (line.py reads this list — E16, 2026-10-21: one place says what runs)

steps.what: edit_map.py --hooks: one edit map per version (the control + every hook opening), takes laid whole and no repairs (V15); the music and SFX the swipe or brief calls for, from production's bank rows, else music_bed.py makes the bed (V14)
mouths.py, every version: the lead's mouth only moves when the lead is heard
render_map.py: picture and sound assembled, the lips held (syncheck), then compose.py draws every word (map_sheet.py)
audit.py, every version: words cut, lips, sync, words on a face or mouth on the finished frames, the swipe's sound
black frames, dead air, loudness, 9:16, every version
watch.py, every version: the house judge (Gemini) watches the finished cut the way a viewer would — product real, one person, lips, words and their bands, no slop, the opening, the offer
thumbs.py: a designed thumbnail per version
the copywriter's words for the ad (brief_words.py)
deliver.py: names, the card, the manifest
meta-upload to_check: the card + videos + thumbnails into 1-check
